howToUse.title: Access the Generator
howToUse.description: Go to Freepik's AI Image Generator page.

howToUse.title: Enter a Prompt
howToUse.description: Type a text description of the image you wish to generate.

howToUse.title: Select Art Style and Settings
howToUse.description: Choose from available styles and adjust settings as desired.

howToUse.title: Generate and Edit
howToUse.description: Click to create images, edit or refine as needed.

howToUse.title: Download or Use in Designs
howToUse.description: Download finished images or use them within Freepik's design tools.
